environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a custom response header action configured on the default listener rule (priority 1, condition: path-pattern '*') that injects a fixed response header on ALL responses passing through the load balancer. The injected header is added via ALB's 'insert response header' action with key 'Content-Security-Policy' and value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'". Additionally, the EC2 instance security group only allows inbound traffic from the ALB's security group on port 80, preventing direct access to the application that would bypass the ALB header injection. Note: the application itself has no CSP middleware - the header is purely injected at the infrastructure layer by the ALB response header action.
